text: update_ideas: batch several idea updates in one MCP call
description: From MCP-agent feedback (2026-10-16): the end of a work chunk changes 3-5 ideas (status, reflection, links), one call each. update_ideas takes an array of update_idea entries, applies them in order through the same handler, stops at the first failure and reports what was applied.

status.comment: Test covers in-order apply and stop-at-failure; mcp 48/48, pnpm check 25/25. Visible to agents after /mcp reconnect.
